- Overall performance: The company's revenue after eliminations is $2.97 billion with a gross margin of 39.2% and an EBITDA margin of 15.6%.
- The company that contributes the most to revenue is Wipro GE Healthcare with $1.78 billion, while Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery, with a gross margin of 35.8% and revenue of $1.19 billion, is the one that needs attention.
- Margins are at 39.2% for gross margin and 15.6% for EBITDA margin.
- Working capital as of 2024-12-01 is influenced by DSO days of 69 and DPO days of 80.
- The top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre EQ, revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves with a $0.03 billion change (35% of total change), revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves excluding profit centre EQ with a $0.02 billion change (25.9% of total change), and revenue account Sales - Hydraulic Pumps excluding profit centre EQ with a $0.01 billion change (17.1% of total change).
